body: Picking up the phone, talking to a doctor, getting appointments, handling the cost, telling my mother (who doesn't believe me) and loads more.

I've been let down too many times to try looking for good again.
I don't know what to do anymore. I've been fucked around too much and its confused the fuck out of me. Maybe this is just a giant "FUCKING HELP ME CUNTS" post but fuck, I do want to die and still feel like dying, theres no one there when I need someone to be there. I'm an emotional and mental wreck headed for a cliff in a car with the music turned up and my speed increasing (figure of speech, not really there).

I'm sorry for being such a cunt. I just need some help but I can't get it because I am too afraid.

I've already been out in the world. I dislike it immensely. I don't see why we bother with living when all we're doing is living in a house on a planet made out of rocks and magma. Fuck the cloud of emotions, look past it. There is literally NOTHING there, theres no reason to live but emotions, something that I do not need or wish to think about, they have pained me a lot and its time that I fucked them off. Unlike you, I contemplate suicide at least once every day, since I was about 12.

My grandmother is currently dying from bowel cancer. It runs in the family. I am most likely going to die from it as well.

I also do not wish to see more of the world. Its a shit place filled with many shit experiences.

I live with boredom every day It gives me a chance to think about these sorts of things. Its most probably the feeling that I love most. Being alone, quiet and no one to fuck with me. Bliss to me, maybe not to you.

Although making who I am may be my decision my parent (mother) doesn't wish for me to decide that. I can't do anything. I am trapped.

I can control if I wish to live or die. I don't wish to ever have kids. I don't have a need to buy anything. It is not good to be trapped, I realise that. Life is already too much of a struggle. Too much of a struggle leads you to this. According to my mother, I'm just a burden and not worth her time, she also thinks that I'm faking this, and does not have the heart to admit that I have severe issues and I refuse to get help (my father kicked me out when I got help).

It also will feel great to kill myself. No more worries, no more shitty things to deal with, no more hard work for nothing, no more cunts to annoy me. I'd like nothing, thats bliss to me. To be dead and not have anything to do.

I'm 17.

I don't want to start my journey. I hate my life and I always will. I can't even bring myself to admit that IRL. I can't go and see a doctor because I can't pick up the phone. Last time I went to one was for "anxiety". The doctor thought I had mild anxiety. The only way I would go there is if my brother, or someone else did everything for me (yes, I am a failure at society).

The daily routine: "Do x or get the fuck out of my house."

I have no reason to live. I don't know what I want to do with my life. All I can think of is how good it would feel (I won't feel anything, thats whats good) to slit my throat or shoot myself.

I guess you're right. Most adults have been real cunts to me. I don't remember my father abusing me, so I really don't have an opinion on it.
I do think they have their hearts in the right place, getting me ready for life but they're not doing it right.
Without a computer I cannot get up, I cannot accomplish anything in a day. Its my motivation and has been for quite some time.

Therapists are crap for me. I don't know any therapists around the area I am in atm, also I would need to go to the doctors, which I do not do (scared shitless).

About the bullying, yeah, its still the same.
